newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wheelock offers 22 luxury houses in HK.
newsitem.headline: Wheelock offers 22 luxury houses in HK.

text.p: Wheelock Properties Ltd said on Wednesday it launched sales of 22 of its luxury duplex houses in phase 3 of its Forest Hill development.

The houses in Tai Po in the New Territories, comprise eight garden houses, four terrace houses and 10 penthouses, and are between 1,800 and 3,100 square feet each and priced at HK$11,448,000 per unit upwards.
Prices of plush Hong Kong properties have been on the rise in the past year, due partly to speculation, and have sparked calls for government intervention.
This led the Hong Kong Monetary Authority in January to recommend that banks limit mortgage lending for purchases of luxury properties.

Wheelock said in its statement that in keeping with guidelines of the Real Estate Developers Association of Hong Kong, individual buyers would have priority in choosing the first 85 percent of units on offer while the remaining 15 percent would be open to company purchasers.
The 22 units would be open for registration between March 8 and 12 and results of computer balloting would be announced on March 14. Official sales would begin on March 15, it said.
